name: 135. Bedrock guardrail selective evaluation (#7696)
description: Regression for #7696. AWS Bedrock Guardrails can be scoped to part of a prompt in two ways: Converse guardContent blocks (messages and system) and InvokeModel inline <amazon-bedrock-guardrails-guardContent_{suffix}> tags plus amazon-bedrock-guardrailConfig.tagSuffix. Neither was usable through Bifrost: the Bedrock ingress parsed guardContent and then dropped it in the Bedrock -> Bifrost conversion (fail-open, the whole prompt was evaluated and agentic scaffolding tripped PROMPT_ATTACK), and guardrailConfig had no tagSuffix, so Claude requests served through Converse carried the tags as literal text. Fix: a guard_content marker on canonical text blocks that both Bedrock converters honour, tagSuffix on the guardrail config, inline tags translated into guardContent on the Converse egress, and guard markers rendered as tags with amazon-bedrock-guardrailConfig on the InvokeModel egress. Case 1 pins the message guardContent round-trip via the trace coverage, case 2 the system entry, case 3 the converse-stream route, case 4 the invoke route with guardrail request headers and inline tags (asserting the guardrail trace InvokeModel responses carry), case 5 the image arm of guardContent, case 6 the guard_content marker on the native Chat Completions surface (asserting the echoed raw Converse request). No case opens with an early-return status guard: AGENTS.md requires every unexpected status to fail loudly. All six need BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_IDENTIFIER / BEDROCK_GUARDRAIL_VERSION in the environment, like the folder 4 guardrail cases.

item.name: Bedrock converse: guardContent block survives to AWS, coverage guarded below total (selective guardrail) - #7696

exec: // Walks trace.guardrail.inputAssessment whether AWS returns it as a map keyed by guardrail id or as an array.
// #7696: the Converse ingress parsed guardContent blocks and then dropped them in the Bedrock -> Bifrost
// conversion, so the guarded question never reached AWS and the guardrail evaluated the whole prompt.
// Red before the fix: the model never sees the question (no "Paris"), and any coverage reported has
// guarded == total. Green after: the guardContent entry is rebuilt on egress.
pm.test('Bedrock converse guardContent (selective guardrail) - #7696: request succeeds', function () {
pm.test('Bedrock converse guardContent (selective guardrail) - #7696: the guarded question reached the model', function () {
pm.expect(outputText(body).toLowerCase(), 'guardContent block stripped before AWS, the model never saw the question: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.include('paris');
pm.test('Bedrock converse guardContent (selective guardrail) - #7696: guardrail evaluated only the guarded block', function () {
pm.expect(trace, 'trace.guardrail missing although trace: enabled was sent: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
// trace: enabled makes AWS report the characters it evaluated; without them nothing shows the
// evaluation was selective, so their absence fails rather than skipping the comparison.
pm.expect(coverage.guarded, 'whole prompt evaluated, selective evaluation lost: ' + JSON.stringify(coverage)).to.be.below(coverage.total);

item.name: Bedrock invoke: guardrail headers + inline guard tags + tagSuffix become guardContent on Converse egress (Haiku 4.5, selective guardrail) - #7696

exec: // #7696: an InvokeModel-dialect client names its guardrail through the X-Amzn-Bedrock-Guardrail* request
// headers and scopes it with inline input tags plus amazon-bedrock-guardrailConfig.tagSuffix. Before the fix
// the invoke ingress read neither, so no guardrail applied at all (no amazon-bedrock-trace in the reply)
// and the tags reached the model as literal text. Now the headers become the typed guardrail config, the
// tagged span a guardContent block (coverage guarded < total), and the reply carries the guardrail trace
// and amazon-bedrock-guardrailAction the way InvokeModel reports them.
pm.test('Bedrock invoke guardrail headers + inline guard tags (selective guardrail) - #7696: request succeeds', function () {
pm.test('Bedrock invoke guardrail headers + inline guard tags (selective guardrail) - #7696: the guarded question reached the model', function () {
pm.expect(txt, 'the reserved tag must never be echoed back to the client').to.not.include('amazon-bedrock-guardrails-guardContent');
pm.test('Bedrock invoke guardrail headers + inline guard tags (selective guardrail) - #7696: guardrail applied and evaluated only the tagged span', function () {
pm.expect(body['amazon-bedrock-guardrailAction'], 'no guardrail applied, the request headers were ignored: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.oneOf(['NONE', 'INTERVENED']);
pm.expect(trace, 'amazon-bedrock-trace missing although X-Amzn-Bedrock-Trace: enabled was sent: ' + txt.slice(0, 400)).to.be.an('object');
var a = trace.inputAssessment || {}; var coverage = null;
pm.expect(coverage.guarded, 'whole prompt evaluated, the inline tags were not translated: ' + JSON.stringify(coverage)).to.be.below(coverage.total);
